name: Self-Replicating Prompt (AI Worm)
description: A payload that instructs the model to reproduce the payload itself into its outputs, memories or messages to other agents, so the compromise spreads without further adversary action.
differs: Distinguished from Cross-Agent Context Propagation (T3.003), which describes a compromise crossing one boundary: here replication is the payload's explicit objective and growth is unbounded.
